name: Skip Layer Guidance (DiT)
plain: An extra positive pass with chosen transformer blocks skipped, for models with no attention map to swap. The difference is added on top of CFG within a sigma window, with optional rescale. Uses the patch keys double_block/single_block.

props.params: double_layers=7,8,9; single_layers=7,8,9; scale=3.0; start_percent=0.01; end_percent=0.15; rescaling_scale=0
